prompts.cast_extra_a:
Use case: illustration-story. Production transparent sprite atlas for the existing cozy game. STRICT uniform 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW grid, sixteen isolated full-body figures, equal invisible cells, square canvas ideally 2048x2048, generous transparent gutters. NO labels, text, grid lines, ground, cast shadows, paper, white background or die-cut border. Each ROW is ONE character in four views: column 1 front, column 2 front three-quarter LEFT, column 3 LEFT profile, column 4 back three-quarter LEFT. Same identity, size, clothes and colors in every column. Full body and feet clear of cell edges, 75% cell height. Style: the user's soft hand-drawn comic characters: simple tiny DARK bean eyes, tiny expressive mouth, cheek blush and little blush hatches, gently wobbly warm-grey pencil contours, soft matte pastel watercolor-gouache fills, irregular fluffy silhouettes. No white eyeballs, glossy sphere eyes, 3D rendering, plastic, faceted shapes, cylinders, perfect circles, gradients or vector emoji. 
ROW 1: Brumme the carpenter bear: warm caramel brown b98657, pale tan belly d3a77a and cream muzzle e9d2b0, small rounded ears, pear-shaped compact body, brown carpenter tool belt with pouches, tiny hammer and pencil, pink toe pads, tiny kind dark eyes. Standing upright, no huge handheld tools.
ROW 2: Natteblik the bat map seller: muted lavender body 8c7aa8, deep mauve wing membranes 6b5b8a, lighter lilac belly a896c4 and ear linings c9a7d6, very large soft pointed ears, little folded-open wings at sides, two tiny dark brown eyes, little teeth and friendly shy smile. Keep wings compact enough to fit every cell, no clipping.
ROW 3: Pip the hedgehog postman: chocolate ragged tufted spines 7a4e2d, soft cream face f0dcc0, warm belly 8a5a32, tiny stubby feet 5e3b20, faded BLUE mail satchel 5d8fc4 on a shoulder strap, little white letter with RED wax seal c4506a held in paws. Organic fluffy spines, not triangles.
ROW 4: Fru Ugle the wise owl appraiser: softly rounded brown owl a07a55 with darker wings 7a5a3a, cream face discs f0dcc0/e2c9a4, small gold rings f2c14e around TINY charcoal bean eyes, small honey beak e8b04a, gentle chest chevrons and small ear tufts, tiny feet, warm gentle expression. No giant circular eyes.

prompts.icons_tools:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production inventory ICON ATLAS, transparent background, strict 4 COLUMN by 4 ROW grid of SIXTEEN distinct isolated objects in row-major order, square canvas ideally 2048x2048. Equal invisible cells, each object centred at about 70% cell width/height with wide transparent gutters. No overlap, labels, letters, numerals, visible grid, white background, paper, ground, cast shadows, circles behind items or white die-cut border. Style matches detailed cozy painted cottage art and soft comic characters: hand-painted watercolor/gouache, gently wobbly warm charcoal-brown contour, earthy muted colors, small worn material detail and subtle paper tooth.
